chunks: Humayd ibn Ziyad from al-Hasan ibn Muhammad from someone else from Aban ibn Uthman from al-Fudayl ibn Yasar who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the marriage of the Nasibi, so he said: No, by Allah, it is not permissible.

Al-Fudayl said: Then I asked him once again, so I said: May I be sacrificed for you, what do you say regarding their marriage? He said: And the woman is one who understands ( Wilayah)? I said: She understands. He said: The understanding woman is not placed (married) except with an understanding man.

key_terms.النَّاصِبِ: Nasibi (one hostile to the Ahl al-Bayt)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on marrying a Nasibi according to Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him)?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi delineates the marital status of the Nasibi (hostile to the Ahl al-Bayt), with Imam al-Sadiq (AS) initially declaring the marriage impermissible (la yahiyyu). Upon further inquiry, he clarifies that an 'aware' woman (al-'arifah) is not placed with just anyone, suggesting that while the general ruling is strict, the specific status of the woman and her knowledge of Wilayah introduces a nuance of compatibility or exclusivity in the marital bond.
